high_level_description: This image shows a close-up view of a traditional Indian rangoli design on a dark-colored floor mat. The rangoli is made using white powder or chalk and features intricate geometric patterns with floral motifs. The design includes symmetrical elements such as swirls, lines, and shapes that form a central motif surrounded by smaller decorative patterns. The setting appears to be indoors, possibly near an entrance, as there is a glimpse of a light-colored wall and a black baseboard at the top of the image.
